description: Justice Brad Mendheim was appointed as an Associate Justice of the Alabama Supreme Court by Governor Kay Ivey in January 2018. Prior to his appointment by Governor Ivey, Justice Mendheim served continuously as an Alabama judge since 2001, including as a circuit judge for the 20th Judicial Circuit, covering Henry (Abbeville) and Houston (Dothan) Counties and as district judge of Houston County beginning in 2001.
